symptom: Both connected-home tracks diverged on eleven groups of layout, copy, icon and first-visit behavior.
direct_cause: The walk compared font sizes and sibling rows but omitted board geometry, icon identity, contextual English and persistent mount effects.
class_root: The approved rows had shared markup without independent acceptance values for the visible details or a test of opening the page on a fresh profile.
affected_population: Connected profiles viewing model settings in Chinese and English
Fresh and returning users opening the assisted entry
entry_points: Assisted provider setup and other connection methods
internal_only_reason: The approved ModelSurfaces board and issue #1704 measurements define the application-specific target.
invariants: Account metrics meet the outer card edges and their values, links and storage label use the approved typography.
Both entry controls have the same row geometry per line. Opening the page does not mark the assisted entry as seen.
generality_proof: Both the details summary and the navigation button consume ModelEntryRow. Account geometry is owned by one definition list for all account states.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Shared entry box and text metrics.
Shared layout of balance, quota and usage.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses the common entry shell and text without first-visit presentation.
Uses the same shell and text for the plug entry.

recurrence.reason: Three successive reviews found additional dimensions of the same approved surface.
same_class_scan: Ran door-map for ModelEntryText and ModelAccountCard.
Searched all assisted title, firstSeen and storage-key uses and compared the Main, M1-en and M1-dark board DOM.
Traced the entry shell and both English dictionary definitions in addition to direct readers. The first-visit storage read and write were removed.

prevention.invariant: Entry geometry and typography are defined once for both entry controls.
prevention.failure_mode: A changed row, account measurement, English label or first-visit storage write fails the connected-home regression.
prevention.strategy: Share intrinsic row metrics, move padding inside account cells, and remove first-visit state at its source.

legacy_paths.rationale: Retire first-visit storage effects, component state and DOM attribute together.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing React, Tailwind and Tabler implementations support all approved values.

migration: The obsolete seen flag can remain inert on old profiles. The independent legacy migration notice retains its dismissal state.
residual_risks: Electron geometry and refreshed screenshots require the host desktop.
